layout_notes.text: RthJA 50 K/W and the TA-based ratings (ID 39 A, Ptot 3.0 W) hold only with 6 cm2 of one-layer 70 um drain copper on a 40x40x1.5 mm FR4 board, vertical, still air (notes 2 and 6).
Package PG-TDSON-8-U08: D 4.80-5.35 mm, E 5.70-6.10 mm, A 0.90-1.20 mm, pitch e 1.27 mm, exposed pad D1 3.90-4.40 mm x E1 4.03-4.25 mm (Figure 1).
Use the recommended PG-TDSON-8 board pads and stencil apertures (Figure 2).

gaps: Re-extracted by the critic from the board part datasheet BSC011N03LS Rev. 2.6 (attempt 1 had used the sister part BSC011N03LSI Rev. 2.5, now discarded).
No recommended operating conditions section in the datasheet; thermal and electrical characteristics are stored in recommended_operating with their test conditions.
No VDS line in the maximum ratings table (p3); VDS 30 V taken from Table 1 (p1) and V(BR)DSS min (p5).
Static characteristics (p5) give no Tj for RDS(on); assumed 25 C. RDS(on) vs Tj is only Diagram 9 (p9), at VGS=10 V; no max at high temperature for VGS=4.5 V, the board gate drive is 5 V.
Exposed pad has no pin number in the datasheet; the bottom view (p11) shows it joined to pins 5-8 (drain). Confirm against the footprint.
No gate drive recommendation (gate resistor, pull-down) in the datasheet.
Datasheet quirk: the cover and page footers say Rev. 2.6 2024-05-11, the revision history (p14) says Rev. 2.6 2024-06-04.
Switching times are given at VGS=10 V only (p5); none at 4.5-5 V gate drive.
